claim: GPT-4 Turbo has a context window of 128,000 tokens.

evidence.quote: GPT-4 also known as GPT-4-0613 (GPT 4 Points GPT-4-0613), has a context window of 8,192 tokens, while GPT-4 turbo (Points GPT-4-0125-preview) has a context window of 128,000 tokens.
evidence.source_title: What is the context window of gpt 4 - API - OpenAI Developer Community

evidence.quote: It has a 128k context window so it can fit the equivalent of more than 300 pages of text in a single prompt.
evidence.source_title: New models and developer products announced at DevDay | OpenAI
